_help: Add one entry per company. type 'oracle_hcm' covers any careers site whose URL looks like https://<host>/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/<lang>/sites/<site_number>/... . 'countries' is optional: list ISO country codes to keep (e.g. ["AE"]); leave it out to keep every location. type 'jsearch' pulls LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt and other job-board posts through the JSearch API: it needs a JSEARCH_API_KEY repository secret, each query uses one of the free plan's 200 requests a month per run (3 queries x 2 runs a day = about 180), and an optional 'publishers' list such as ["LinkedIn"] keeps only those boards.
